tools.name: list_styles
tools.description: List 16 local rendering presets, aliases, style overrides and platform safe areas. This remote server returns the catalog; render via the local MCP.

tools.name: list_fonts
tools.description: List named font IDs, licenses and script coverage. Pass font_id in local rendering overrides; no cloud video rendering.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Current API prices and monthly free allowances, no key needed.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Current usage, estimated bill and monthly spend cap for your configured API key.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate additional cloud charges and available allowance before a batch. Includes active budget holds; does not reserve credit.

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe extracted audio into segments and word timestamps. Max 12 MB decoded. Never send video. Charged by audio duration past the free allowance.

tools.name: correct_captions
tools.description: Correct caption text, preserving caption count and order. Does not realign word timing. Billed by input characters.

tools.name: translate_captions
tools.description: Translate caption lines, preserving count and order. Target-language word timing is estimated by the local renderer. Billed by input characters.

tools.name: pick_emojis
tools.description: Pick one emoji for each caption. Billed by input characters.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_styles" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List 15 local rendering presets, aliases, style overrides and platform safe areas. This remote server returns the catalog; render via the local MCP." → after: "List 16 local rendering presets, aliases, style overrides and platform safe areas. This remote server returns the catalog; render via the local MCP."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
